headline: WSN @ CLE matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is WSN 3.14 at CLE 4.26, with a projected total of 7.40. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward WSN: WSN moved -0.75 runs while CLE moved -1.98, changing the projected margin by +1.23 runs. The projected total fell -2.73, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +6.4%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Miles Mikolas has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Dylan Crews, James Wood, Travis Bazzana, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags José Tena, Kyle Manzardo because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
